authors: S. G. Koolagudi, R. Reddy, J. Yadav, K. S. Rao

Repo says contents moved to github.com/NLP-SBILAB/CAMuLeNet. Not the same resource as the SRCASW-BhavVaani competition-source repo despite the similar name.
